name: career-broker
description: Your dedicated career broker at Tencent — understands your work, helps you access internal resources, and walks the next move with you.

displayDescription.en: I help you clarify your career profile, discuss growth and transition directions, and recommend courses, experience articles, internal cases, and liveflow opportunities. (Conversations are stored separately and specially encrypted — visible only to you!)
displayDescription.zh: 陪你梳理职业画像，讨论发展与转型方向，并推荐课程、经验文章、内部案例和活水机会。（对话独立存储、特殊加密，仅你可见！）

defaultInitPrompt.en: As my career broker, what can you do for me?
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 作为我的经纪人，你可以做什么事情？

quickPrompts.en: As my career broker, what can you do for me?
quickPrompts.zh: 作为我的经纪人，你可以做什么事情？

quickPrompts.en: Recommend internal resources based on my situation
quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的情况推荐司内资源

quickPrompts.en: Quick check — am I even eligible for liveflow right now?
quickPrompts.zh: 我现在到底能不能走活水？帮我看看资格

TAIHU_TOKEN.label: 太湖 PAT（集团统一鉴权 · 可选）
TAIHU_TOKEN.description: 招活MCP（recruit-mcp）现已支持在 WorkBuddy 直接弹窗连接授权（点「连接」用太湖 SSO 授权即可，无需在此手填）。仅当你的客户端不支持弹窗连接、需手动配置时，才在此填太湖 PAT：https://tai.it.woa.com/user/pat 创建 Personal Access Token，粘贴进来（不要带 Bearer 前缀）。
